paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between original Consistency-CE model and ours proposed Consistency-Bi model for wait-1 testing under prefix-constrained decoding setting.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between “the length of gold prefix” and “BLEU” scores for two models, Consistency-CE and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis is labeled “the length of gold prefix”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 20, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU”, has a linear scale, ranges from 23 to 29, and has tick labels at intervals of 1. A blue dashed line with circle markers represents the Consistency-CE model; it begins at approximately (0, 25.5) and ends at approximately (20, 28), exhibiting an initial increase to around (5, 26.5), then a slight decline, and finally an upward trend. An orange solid line with square markers represents the Consistency-Bi model; it begins at approximately (0, 27.4) and ends at approximately (20, 24.3). This line shows a decrease from approximately (0, 27.4) to approximately (10, 25.3), then levels off around (15, 24.4).
